_comment: CUSTOMIZE: Copy this file to config.local.json and review every field below. Relative paths start at the folder that holds the config file.

dashboards._comment_paths: CUSTOMIZE: List dashboard JSON files, or directories searched recursively for *.json. Keep the allow-empty file outside these directories.
dashboards._comment_datasource: CUSTOMIZE: Keep true when every panel in a dashboard should use one datasource. Set false for dashboards that mix datasources on purpose.

prometheus._comment_url: CUSTOMIZE: Set the Prometheus base URL without /api/v1. A path prefix such as /prometheus is fine.
prometheus._comment_timeout: CUSTOMIZE: Set the timeout for each query in seconds.
prometheus._comment_ca: CUSTOMIZE: For a private HTTPS CA, set its local PEM path. Otherwise leave this empty.
prometheus._comment_bearer: CUSTOMIZE: Set only the environment-variable name that holds a bearer token. Never put the token here.
prometheus._comment_basic_user: CUSTOMIZE: Set the basic-auth username, or leave it empty when basic auth is disabled.
prometheus._comment_basic_password: CUSTOMIZE: Set only the environment-variable name that holds the basic-auth password.

queries._comment_variables: CUSTOMIZE: Map each dashboard template variable, written without $, to the value substituted before a query is sent. .* tests every series a regex matcher can select. Built-in values such as __rate_interval can be overridden here too.
queries._comment_allow_empty: CUSTOMIZE: List exact panel titles that are correct when they return no data, such as a table of recent restarts.
allow_empty_titles: Container restarts in the last 6 hours
queries._comment_allow_empty_file: CUSTOMIZE: Optional JSON file holding a list of panel titles, such as one a dashboard generator writes. Leave empty when unused.
